lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the gill region, high-intensity blobs are organized into distinct vertical columns. A specific arrangement is visible in the mid-flank where six large circular blobs form a semi-circular border around a single central spot. Further posterior, the arrangement transitions into a more uniform grid of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, with large, high-luminance blobs serving as anchor nodes at the intersection points of these vertical stripes and horizontal alignments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed trough on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized distribution of smaller, lower-intensity spots that contrast with the larger, more structured grid-like pattern on the main lateral flank.
